name: filevora

browser.notes: The client entry bundles without Node built-ins. Resumable upload is covered by tests.

notes: A Filevora account is not required and this package cannot create one.
Status tested is used only for behavior covered by an automated test in this repository.

Local verification recorded in runtimes.node.verifiedOn. GitHub Actions runs typecheck, lint, knip, circular, build, and separate test jobs for Redis, S3, Postgres, and MySQL. Local pnpm run ci and the pre-commit hook are unchanged.

Video posters are image/webp. selectPosterEncoder uses FFmpeg libwebp only when ffmpeg -encoders lists it. FFmpeg 8.1.2 on the machine used for local verification has no libwebp encoder, so posters are encoded by Sharp. doctor check ffmpeg-webp warns in that case and does not fail the report.

S3 tests use an in-process path-style emulator. filevora init --profile local-s3 writes a MinIO Compose file and does not start Docker. A networked S3 test runs when FILEVORA_S3_ENDPOINT, FILEVORA_S3_BUCKET, and the access keys are set. Docker was unavailable on the local machine, so that test was skipped. AWS, R2, and MinIO were not certified in this run.

Lite metadata is the default and does not create a database file. A FILEVORA_DATABASE_URL selects stored mode. postgres and postgresql use PostgreSQL, mysql and mariadb use MySQL or MariaDB, and sqlite or a file path uses SQLite. Migrate creates filevora_assets, filevora_asset_versions, and, in stored mode, the tag and filevora_asset_embeddings tables. The processing queue is Redis only.

PDF text extraction reads literal Tj strings from fixtures. pdf.text stores per-page text and document metadata. POST /pdf/merge and POST /files/:id/split create new PDF assets. Office-to-PDF uses LibreOffice soffice and is optional; doctor warns when it is missing and the job fails with PROCESSOR_UNAVAILABLE. Page thumbnails use Poppler pdftoppm (pdf.pages, presets pdf-pages and pdf-cover). When pdftoppm is on PATH, normalize stores a PNG of page 1. A missing binary leaves text extraction working. A page-image job fails with PROCESSOR_UNAVAILABLE. OCR returns OCR_NOT_CONFIGURED.
AI diagnostics were tested with an in-process explainer. No request was sent to OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini.

Upload progress is percent plus bytes on the client task. Resume uses the existing resume store. Host env names are in .env.example. Processing progress for video and audio is SSE read with fetch so host Authorization headers still apply, with JSON polling as fallback. Image jobs emit one terminal event. History is in memory for the page load and refetches short-lived delivery URLs.
catalog is generated from the route table, Zod schemas, the error catalog, and public exports. Edit docs/agents/capabilities.hand.json for feature status and notes, then run pnpm manifest.

Named presets expand to transform operations. The default web-optimized preset still publishes thumbnail, optimized, and hd. Custom presets are a presets object or FILEVORA_PRESETS JSON. See docs/presets.md.

video.poster, video.thumbnails, and video.sprite publish WebP versions through the storage driver. video.sprite also writes a WebVTT file and a JSON timeline. Presets poster, thumbnails, and sprites cover the same operations.

Audio tools use ffmpeg. audio.transcode writes mp3, aac, ogg, or wav. audio.loudnorm uses loudnorm at EBU R128 (-23 LUFS). audio.waveform writes a PNG and JSON peaks. audio.describe writes probe metadata. Presets audio-mp3, audio-aac, audio-loudnorm, audio-waveform, and audio-describe.

Direct S3 upload: POST /uploads/direct signs a single PUT or multipart part URLs. POST /uploads/direct/:sessionId/complete heads the object, checks size and sniffed type, applies the EXIF policy, runs the malware scanner, and queues the same preset pipeline. Filesystem storage cannot sign. Bucket CORS must expose ETag. See docs/direct-upload.md.

Framework helpers are filevora/next, filevora/express, filevora/fastify, filevora/hono, and optional filevora/react. They do not render UI. useUpload and useAssetProgress return state. filevora/client does not import Node builtins.

Gemini descriptions are stored mode only. FILEVORA_GEMINI_API_KEY, FILEVORA_DESCRIBE_ASSETS (default false), and describe on create. POST /files/:id/describe retriggers. GET /files filters tags and description text only when a key is set. Content is sent to Google only when a description runs. See docs/descriptions.md and docs/list.md.

GET /files filters by type, date, size, mime, filename, duration, dimensions, visibility, preset, and processing status in lite and stored mode. tags, tagsAll, q, descriptionStatus, and hasDescription need stored mode and FILEVORA_GEMINI_API_KEY. document means PDF, text, CSV, and Office. There is no separate search endpoint.

Private assets are served with HMAC delivery URLs or S3 presigned URLs. Public assets use /public. FILEVORA_SIGNING_SECRET is a comma-separated key list. A missing asset card is private. See docs/access-control.md.

Every feature is an in-process method on the Files instance from filevora/server (README section Library methods). Each HTTP route calls that method, so validation and error codes match. POST /files/batch is getMany, the progress SSE stream is watchProgress, GET /health is doctor. ctx.policy carries UploadPolicy limits for createUploadSession. verifyWebhookSignature checks received webhooks.
The package is ESM. Node 22.13 and newer can require() the same entry points. filevora worker reads REDIS_URL or FILEVORA_CONFIG_PATH and does not start redis-memory-server.

errors.cause: The host authenticate callback returned no principal.
errors.fix: Sign the user in before calling the file route.

errors.cause: The host authorize callback rejected this operation.
errors.fix: Update the application authorization rule for this principal and operation.

errors.cause: The id is unknown, belongs to another tenant, or was deleted. Cross-tenant access returns not found so existence is not leaked.
errors.fix: Use the file id returned at upload time for this tenant.

errors.cause: The reserved and stored bytes for this tenant are above FILES_TENANT_QUOTA_BYTES or the policy quota.
errors.fix: Raise the tenant quota or delete unneeded files.

errors.cause: The declared or actual size exceeds maxFileBytes.
errors.fix: Raise FILES_MAX_FILE_BYTES only if the host can store and process that size.

errors.cause: The sniffed type is outside the server allow list. Client extensions are not trusted.
errors.fix: Add the sniffed MIME type to the server allow list if the product should accept it.

errors.cause: The upload declared a MIME type that contradicts the byte signature.
errors.fix: Upload the file with a declared type that matches its contents.

errors.cause: The session TTL elapsed before completion. Parts from that session are not reusable.
errors.fix: Create a new upload session and send the remaining bytes under the new id.

errors.cause: Completion was requested before every part was stored and verified.
errors.fix: List the session parts and upload only the missing part numbers.

errors.cause: The concatenated parts are a different length than the size authorized at session creation.
errors.fix: Abort the session and upload the file again with the correct size.

errors.cause: SHA-256 of the assembled object differs from the checksum supplied by the client.
errors.fix: Upload the file again. Do not ignore a checksum mismatch.

errors.cause: The storage driver could not read or write the object.
errors.fix: Check the filesystem permissions or S3 credentials and endpoint.

errors.cause: No live worker heartbeat was found. Embedded mode starts a child on the first job only in a long-running Node process.
errors.fix: Start a worker with npx filevora worker, or enable on-demand spawn in a long-running process.

errors.cause: Serverless and edge runtimes cannot keep a durable child worker. Use a long-running Node host or distributed workers.
errors.fix: Run the app on a long-running Node server, or set FILES_PROCESSING_MODE=distributed and deploy npx filevora worker separately.

errors.cause: The configured FFmpeg or ffprobe path is not an executable. Filevora does not download binaries.
errors.fix: Install FFmpeg and ffprobe for the operating system.

errors.cause: The spawned FFmpeg process exited with an error. Arguments come from the validated recipe, not from the user.
errors.fix: Probe the original with ffprobe. Reject corrupt or unsupported codecs.

errors.cause: The job ran longer than FILES_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS or the per-recipe limit.
errors.fix: Raise the timeout only for trusted inputs, or reduce output size and duration.

errors.cause: Encrypted PDFs are rejected. Filevora does not ask a model to guess the text.
errors.fix: Upload a PDF that does not require a password.

errors.cause: No text layer was found. Filevora will not invent text. OCR is an optional adapter and is not bundled.
errors.fix: Configure an OCR adapter, or accept the no-text result.

errors.cause: One or more rows or the header did not match the requested schema. See the row error artifact.
errors.fix: Correct the source rows or relax the schema. Invalid values are not coerced silently when the policy says collect or fail.

errors.cause: Inactivity deletion needs an evidence source, and age-based deletion must be explicitly enabled. Dry-run before a real sweep.
errors.fix: Run a retention dry-run and review filesEligible before deleting.

errors.cause: Lite mode keeps bytes in object storage and the queue in Redis. Listing, search, and migrate need the host database.
errors.fix: Set FILEVORA_METADATA_MODE=stored and FILEVORA_DATABASE_URL to the host database.

errors.cause: Lite get-by-id probes object storage for {assetId}_original.{ext} under the tenant prefix. A missing key is not found.
errors.fix: Use the assetId returned when the upload session was created, and confirm the original object is in this tenant prefix.

errors.cause: Managed hosting, billing, accounts, and other reserved providers are intentionally unsupported in the open-source package.
errors.fix: Use filesystem or your own S3 and database. A Filevora account is not required and cannot enable this feature.

errors.cause: Typed options and FILES_* variables failed schema validation or contradict each other.
errors.fix: Run config validation and fix the reported field.

errors.cause: Production must name its storage and metadata drivers. Single-host SQLite or filesystem storage must set FILES_SINGLE_HOST_ACK=true. Storage roots under the OS temp directory are rejected.
errors.fix: Point storage at a persistent disk or set an explicit single-host acknowledgement.

errors.cause: Object keys are opaque and must stay inside the storage root. User filenames are never used as keys.
errors.fix: Use the file id returned by Filevora. Do not pass paths from the browser.

errors.cause: The scanner marked the original as infected after it was stored and before encoding. The original was quarantined and no variants were published.
errors.fix: Do not retry this file. Upload a clean copy if the detection was a false positive.

errors.cause: A scanner is configured, but it was unreachable or returned an unusable result. The original was quarantined and encoding did not start.
errors.fix: Check FILEVORA_CLAMAV_HOST and FILEVORA_CLAMAV_PORT, then upload again.

errors.cause: The config does not match the sniffed media type, a preset name is unknown, or a crop, trim, or page list is outside the file. context.field is the offending key, context.reason says why, context.detectedType is the sniffed type, context.validOperations lists operations, and context.validPresets lists preset names when the failure is about a preset.
errors.fix: Use only the operations listed in validOperations for the detected type.

errors.cause: Transforms must use an allowlisted kind. Arbitrary FFmpeg arguments and shell fragments are rejected.
errors.fix: Use a named preset or a typed transform from the recipe reference.

errors.cause: An optional processor such as sharp could not be loaded. Core upload still works without it.
errors.fix: Install the optional dependency named in the error context.

errors.cause: The job was written by a newer Filevora schema than this worker.
errors.fix: Deploy a worker with the same or newer Filevora version, then retry the job.

errors.cause: Repeat the original request body or choose a new idempotency key.
errors.fix: Retry the same payload to receive the original session, or send a new key.

errors.cause: A cancel request stopped the job. Partial outputs were not published.
errors.fix: Enqueue a new processing job if the variant is still needed.

errors.cause: Only http and https are accepted. file, ftp, and other schemes are rejected.
errors.fix: Pass an http or https URL with no other scheme.

errors.cause: A username or password in the URL is rejected so it is not sent or logged.
errors.fix: Remove the username and password from the URL.

errors.cause: The default allowed ports are 80 and 443. Add the port to FILEVORA_REMOTE_ALLOWED_PORTS when a local server uses another port.
errors.fix: Set FILEVORA_REMOTE_ALLOWED_PORTS to include this port.

errors.cause: FILEVORA_REMOTE_HOST_DENY always rejects a host. FILEVORA_REMOTE_HOST_ALLOW, when set, rejects every host that is not listed.
errors.fix: Change the host allowlist or denylist.

errors.cause: Loopback, private, link-local, multicast, and cloud metadata addresses are blocked. DNS answers are checked, and the connection uses a checked address. FILEVORA_REMOTE_ALLOW_PRIVATE=true allows private addresses on the URL you pass, not on a redirect.
errors.fix: Use a public http or https URL. For a local server, set FILEVORA_REMOTE_ALLOW_PRIVATE=true.

errors.cause: Each redirect is checked with the same rules. A redirect to a private address is rejected even when private addresses are allowed on the original URL. The hop limit is FILEVORA_REMOTE_MAX_REDIRECTS.
errors.fix: Pass the final public URL, or raise FILEVORA_REMOTE_MAX_REDIRECTS.

errors.cause: The connect timeout is FILEVORA_REMOTE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS. The whole download, including redirects, stops at FILEVORA_REMOTE_TIMEOUT_MS.
errors.fix: Raise the timeout or retry when the host is slow.

errors.cause: Webhook targets must be HTTPS in production. Loopback and private addresses are rejected so the worker cannot be used as a proxy.
errors.fix: Register an HTTPS endpoint that you control.

errors.cause: The token is not a base64 payload plus an HMAC. It was truncated or was not produced by signUrl.
errors.fix: Call signUrl again and use the returned URL unchanged.

errors.cause: The HMAC does not match any configured signing key. The URL was edited, or it was signed by a key that has been removed.
errors.fix: Keep the previous key in FILEVORA_SIGNING_SECRET while tokens signed with it are still valid.

errors.cause: exp is in the past. Delivery URLs are short-lived. Request a new one.
errors.fix: Call signUrl or GET the versions route again.

errors.cause: The per-asset url salt changed after this token was signed. Older URLs no longer match.
errors.fix: Issue a new URL. Rotate the salt only when existing links should die.

errors.cause: The token contains an ip claim and the request IP does not match it.
errors.fix: Sign again without ip, or from the client that will fetch the URL.

errors.cause: The plain /public URL is only for visibility public. A missing asset card is private.
errors.fix: Fetch a signed /content URL, or set visibility to public when that is intended.

errors.cause: Filevora sends the asset to Google Gemini only when a key is configured. The asset itself is still stored.
errors.fix: Set FILEVORA_GEMINI_API_KEY to a Google AI Studio key, then retry the description.

errors.cause: Queries over tags stay on the host database. Asset cards and object storage never hold the description text.
errors.fix: Set FILEVORA_DATABASE_URL to postgres://, mysql://, or sqlite://./filevora.sqlite and run npx filevora migrate.

errors.cause: GET /files rejects an unknown type, sort, date, or range instead of ignoring it.
errors.fix: Read the parameter named in the error. type is image, video, document, or audio. sort is created, updated, size, or filename. order is asc or desc.

errors.cause: POST /files/search rejects an empty or oversized query, a minScore outside 0 to 1, a maxResults outside 1 to 1000, an invalid filter, or a cursor that belongs to another query.
errors.fix: Read the field named in the error. query is 1 to 2000 characters, minScore is 0 to 1, maxResults is 1 to 1000. Keep the query, minScore, maxResults, and every filter unchanged when you pass nextCursor, or omit cursor to start over.

errors.cause: Search turns the query into a vector with the Gemini embedding model. The call timed out, was rate limited after retries, returned a 5xx or an unusable vector (retryable), or Google rejected it with 400, 401, 402, or 403 (retryable: false). context.geminiHttpStatus, geminiStatus, geminiMessage, and geminiReason carry Google's answer.
errors.fix: For 429, 5xx, a timeout, or a bad vector: retry the search after a short delay. If it keeps failing, check the Gemini quota.

errors.cause: The asset or version in the token does not exist or was deleted.
errors.fix: Use _original or a version name returned by the versions route.

progress.versions: Record<version, { version, status, url?, mime?, bytes? }>?
